title: Cheeble Geeve's quiet rails
description: Reduces volume and treble content of rail sounds
body: Reduces volume and treble content of rail sounds for an easier-on-the-ears experience on long rides, while listening to music, or while using Voice chat. the files for inside and outside minecarts have been given a high pass and mid cut to leave more room in the "mix" without subtracting from the rail ambiance.
